missionPremise: PARCEL-R1-CROSSWALK (closed, _inbox/2026-09-01_parcel-r1-crosswalk_close.json) proved a fixture-verified crosswalk (situs_address exact match, unique 1:1 gate, no prop_id transform) resolving 257,604 of 282,569 Williamson R-prefix accounts to their dollar/living-bearing numeric CAD counterpart, with 92.2% independent owner-name corroboration and a concrete disproof of any prefix-strip shortcut. This card implements that exact design in the Factory fill job's CAD-loading step and re-runs the county-wide CAD ingest for 48491.
completionPredicate: Met: (1) the crosswalk implemented as designed, PR merged on green CI (7 new tests + 495-suite green); (2) factory-parcel-record-fill image rebuilt and redeployed, ENGINE_SHA unchanged; (3) county-wide re-ingest for 48491 executed via Cloud Run with --apply --twice, zero-drift idempotency proven; (4) improvementValue/assessedValue/landValue moved from 282,569 unaccounted to 257,604 value / 24,966 unaccounted, matching R1's predicted 257,604/24,965 split to within a single row; (5) livingAreaSqft/yearBuilt show lower but honestly-explained coverage (source gaps at the matched row, not a defect); (6) marketValue/legalDescription show near-total coverage, confirming the merge correctly favored each R-prefix row's own pre-existing data over the crosswalk; (7) 4 of 4 spot-checks against R1's verbatim fixture pairs match exactly, including the negative-control ambiguous case (64-way fan-out) correctly staying unaccounted; (8) the R-prefix row's own market_value was proven preserved against the crosswalk's differing figure in a live production row, not only in the unit test.
scopeBasis: hauska-factory src/jobs/parcel-record-fill.mjs and its test file only (PR #60). No schema.sql change, no engine-core change, no touch to any county other than 48491 (verified: loadWilliamsonCrosswalk is a hard no-op, zero queries, for every other county fips). Execution was Cloud Run only (factory-parcel-record-fill --apply is LAPTOP_WRITE_FROZEN-gated, unchanged).

beforeAfterByRail.before: assessedValue, improvementValue, landValue, livingAreaSqft, yearBuilt: ALL 282,569 unaccounted (0 value, 0 absent-verified) -- verified by direct query immediately before execution
beforeAfterByRail.explanation: The three rails with identical 257,604/24,966 splits (improvement/assessed/land) are exactly the crosswalk's own match/residue boundary. livingAreaSqft and yearBuilt show additional unaccounted beyond that boundary because a subset of matched numeric-roll rows themselves lack living_area_sqft (or have 0, which the unchanged >0 module rule correctly keeps unaccounted) or year_built -- a source gap at the crosswalk target, not a join failure. marketValue and legalDescription show FEWER unaccounted than the crosswalk boundary because those fields were already present on most R-prefix rows before this card ran, and mergeWilliamsonCrosswalk's never-overwrite rule correctly left them alone.

counts.countingRule: parcel_record_cell.cell_state->>'kind' grouped by rail_key for county_fips=48491 AND prop_id ~ '^R[0-9]+$', read directly from FACTORY_DATABASE_URL after the re-ingest

whatContradictedTheCard: The dispatch's verify step named an exact predicted count (257,604) without naming a tolerance; the actual residue is 24,966 against a predicted 24,965 -- a single-row, 0.0004% gap. An isolating query (parcel_record LEFT JOIN parcel_record_cell WHERE apn unaccounted, to check for a genuinely CAD-row-less R-prefix parcel) timed out on the live store and was not re-run under a longer statement_timeout, since the magnitude did not warrant further live-store scan time given every other measured figure (marketValue, legalDescription, the four spot-checked fixture pairs, the ambiguous-case negative control) matched exactly or was explained by a named, verified mechanism. This is reported as an open, unresolved single-row discrepancy rather than forced to zero.
constraintsHonored: no prop_id transform, verified by SQL-text assertion in the test suite and confirmed live (R022482 stayed unaccounted, proving no fallback heuristic fired)
never overwrote an R-prefix row's own value, verified live on R000009 (market_value 401306 preserved against the crosswalk's 394000)
ambiguous match never resolved by a guess, verified live on R022482
Cloud Run only; LAPTOP_WRITE_FROZEN guard unchanged and untouched
no county other than 48491 touched (loadWilliamsonCrosswalk verified as a hard no-op elsewhere)

LESSON: A crosswalk implemented purely as a Factory-side data-join (never touching engine-core) is verifiable end-to-end against real fixture pairs from the design card that proved it -- the same 50 verbatim pairs used to prove the design can be re-used, unmodified, to verify the execution.

When a rail has an additional module-level rule (livingAreaSqft's >0 requirement), its post-crosswalk coverage will legitimately be lower than a sibling rail sharing the same match/residue boundary -- report the mechanism, do not chase the number to match a sibling rail.
